topic: Analyzing sensor anomalies in Finland data
summary_markdown:
A discussion arose regarding sensor anomalies observed in Finland. Specifically, a discrepancy was noted: the anomaly (a peak) appeared in session data but not in real-time data, which someone had previously noticed.

One participant suggested that this might be because only 'real calibrated' data enters the system from the sessioner in real-time mode. The other participant pointed out that Finland does not have a specific model and that the dashboard there also uses real-time data.
action_items: Review sensor anomaly data for Finland, comparing real-time vs. session metrics.
